PermataBank’s implementation of sustainable finance

records.text: PermataBank realizes that to support the achievement of the SDGs, PermataBank needs commitment from all relevant stakeholders.
This commitment is reflected in PermataBank’s implementation of sustainable finance actions that began in 2019.

The implementation of sustainable finance actions in PermataBank’s operations is an act of support from PermataBank to nurture sustainable economic growth by considering economic, social, and environmental interests.
This implementation is also reflected in the Sustainability Report prepared every year by PermataBank.
